reviewed_evidence.topic: Logical fields, raw versus enriched information and calculation versus writes
reviewed_evidence.assessment: Written snapshots correctly distinguish multi-value ARTIST from slash TRACK, first value from meta_sep, path from TITLE and computed information from writable tags. Calculation alone performs no write.

reviewed_evidence.topic: Conflicting native MP3 blocks and read/write/remove policy
reviewed_evidence.assessment: APE -> ID3v2 -> ID3v1 reads choose one enabled present tag, without merging ALBUM from another. Ordinary write/remove interaction and MPEG UTF16 default agree with source. Raw AAC/TTA policy statement agrees with raw_streams adapter, not only FileType policy.

reviewed_evidence.topic: Native track/disc pairs and numbering workflow
reviewed_evidence.assessment: TRCK/TPOS and MP4 trkn/disk, TOTALTRACKS/TOTALDISCS readback and u16/conflict restrictions match. Adjacent reset boundaries and run-ending total are correct. Preview then pending stage then Save tags matches production flow.
